title: Deadlock Lobby Ranks
description:
Rank badges next to every player in the Escape menu player list.

- A rank badge per player, from the [deadlock-api.com](https://deadlock-api.com/) rank image
- Party markers (optional): coloured person icons left of the rank for players on the same team who are Steam friends, via deadlock-api.com and the [party bridge page](https://luxus.github.io/deadlock-mods/party/)
- Two paks installed together in load order: the list layout and script (pak01) and an entry hook that exposes account ids (pak02)
- A "Lobby Ranks" tab in [CompLock HUD++](https://deadlockconfig.com/), or an ADDONS window in the Esc menu without HUD++
- Written from scratch, MIT
author: luxus
